Before you test

  1. DLF Hospitality UAT has real people in it. Name every workflow “QA_Platform …”, make yourself its only approver, delete it when done.
  2. Never submit through the company “test” workflows — they go to all DLF super admins / managers / members.
  3. Use RFX-2112 (vendor Demo10). After a submit, reject or withdraw your own request and open a new draft so the event stays reusable.
  4. Do not touch the “hello”, “GD Test …” and “test” workflows.
  5. On DLF, “Submit Proposal” first opens the NTD page; the approval window comes after its own “Submit Proposal”.

The flow (pass / cases)

Test cases

Rules behind the cases

What decides the approval
Five dropdowns in the PO form's General Details: Form Type (the event's template, locked), Unit Name (the PR line's location, or the buyer's teams' units), Legal Entity (depends on Unit Name), Department, Nature of Expense. Sanction Note and Comments are notes only.
How a workflow is matched
Only Bid Proposal workflows whose team includes the buyer in the stated role (Member/Manager/Admin) count. If any TEAM workflow matches, the COMPANY ones are ignored. Each condition means 'the PO's value is one of these'; every condition must hold; a field without a condition accepts any value. Total Proposal Value and the older conditions combine the same way.
What Submit does
One match: used. Several: the buyer picks. None: the PO cannot be submitted (never reachable on DLF UAT while the three company 'test' workflows exist). Required field empty: 'Please fill …'. Chosen workflow no longer matching: 'Invalid Approval' and the list reloads.
After Submit
General Details become read-only; the request records the values, the workflow, how many matched and whether the buyer chose. Reject or withdraw → a new draft with the same values.
Where the lists come from
Form Type: event templates. Unit Name: the company's locations (34 on UAT, some junk). Legal Entity, Department, Nature of Expense: uploaded data rows, the entity rows mapped to units. The builder's values come from a sync script a developer runs.
Asked for but not built
Lists in the builder that follow the unit; an overlap warning; choosing a lone entity automatically; keeping a still-valid entity when the unit changes; General Details on the approver's page; PO list filters and export; locking an auto-filled Unit Name.
